title: Hardware quirks model for Medium simulator
description:
Model real radio hardware imperfections:

1. **Warm-up time**: TX/RX mode switch takes 1-5ms, packets during transition are lost
2. **PLL lock failures**: Occasional frequency lock failure (0.1-1% of TX attempts), retry needed
3. **Crystal drift**: ±10-30ppm frequency offset, affects capture effect and collision detection
4. **RSSI accuracy**: Real RSSI has ±3dB error, add noise to reported values
5. **RX deaf time**: After TX, radio is deaf for ~100μs (TX/RX turnaround)
6. **CAD false positives/negatives**: Real CAD has ~5% error rate

Implementation: Optional RadioQuirks config on SimRadio, disabled by default for deterministic tests.
